'''Scorpions''' were predatory, venomous arthropods. Varieties were found on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].

==History==
One [[Species/Legends|species]] was native to [[Solay]]. One sting meant instant [[Death/Legends|death]] to many species. [[Braxas]] was known to test people by placing a scorpion in a bowl of [[Worm/Legends|worms]] and forcing them to eat the worms with [[Chopstick/Legends|chopsticks]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was tested in this way before he [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] Braxas off the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-seized planet.<ref name="MC89">[[Star Wars (1977) 89|''Star Wars'' (1977) 89]]</ref>

A [[Ziost scorpion|species]] of scorpion that lived on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] was prey to a [[Ziost rodent|rodent]] species.<ref name="TotJ:GAotS3" />

Another subspecies, known as the '''sandscorpion''', inhabited to the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were known to come in different sizes, with some creatures being much larger than others. [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] apparently found them to be an edible delicacy, and would tend to eat them alive.<ref name="Hunted">''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]''</ref>

The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[D'harhan]] owned a [[D'harhan's ship|ship]] that, when docked, would have its mesh seine curl over the back of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], much like a scorpion's tail.<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>

"Scorpion" was often used in the name of independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] operating throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>
